goal: Roll the invitation-derived brand across the site, make named plus-ones first-class Guests, add the registry link and themed QR, ship the admin roster, force HTTPS, and verify the rebranded gated site live on angelaandbrooks.com.

shipped.title: Apply invitation-derived theme palette
shipped.summary: Replace the nine theme color roles in theme.config.ts with a palette sampled from the invitation proof (cream/blush bg, fig-burgundy primary, forest+sage greens, dark text), contrast-verified, tokens-only.

shipped.title: Harmonize font sizes into a type-scale token system
shipped.summary: Introduce a font-size token scale and adopt it across components, removing the pre-existing Georgia, serif fallback; folds backlog issue 019eeb89.

shipped.title: Crop, optimize, and upload the home hero photo
shipped.summary: Crop the 28MB portrait original to 16:9, optimize to <=2000px / <=500KB for the committed public/hero.jpg, and preserve the original under docs/source_material/ so the asset stays under Cloudflare's 25MB limit.

shipped.title: Named plus-ones become first-class Guests (RSVP write-back)
shipped.summary: Per ADR 019eebb3-f8db: mint a guest_id for a named +1 at submit, stamp it on the rsvps row, and append the +1 to official-guest-list with a new source column, idempotent on (party_id + normalized name); is_plus_one becomes source==plus-one.

shipped.title: Add the wedding registry link to the Registry page
shipped.summary: Add a tokens-only registry link/button to the couple's myregistry URL (new tab, rel noopener noreferrer), replacing the placeholder; add an embed only if reversible and low-risk, else document as deferred.

shipped.title: Force HTTPS and add HSTS (fix the "not secure" warning)
shipped.summary: Add a middleware 308 redirect from http to https (via x-forwarded-proto) and a Strict-Transport-Security header so the live apex no longer shows not-secure.

shipped.title: Verify and document go-live on angelaandbrooks.com
shipped.summary: Per ADR 019eebb3-fedc: declare the custom-domain binding in wrangler.jsonc, deploy all Sprint 2 work, and verify https://angelaandbrooks.com serves the rebranded gated site (no not-secure, /admin reachable, valid TLS); document the rollback. Depends on every other Sprint 2 slice plus eb6f and 88b8.

shipped.title: Admin join roster: invited versus replied
shipped.summary: Admin roster joining the Guest List against RSVPs on guest_id, classifying invited versus replied; must account for ADR 019eebb3-f8db (the new source column and RSVP-added +1 rows). Depends on the +1 write-back slice.

shipped.title: Themed QR code pointing at the gated site root
shipped.summary: Palette-tinted QR (SVG + high-res PNG) with the A&B monogram encoding https://angelaandbrooks.com, scan-verified and handed off to the invitation designer. Depends on the palette slice.

defects_discovered.summary: Home hero rendered the 'Photo coming soon' placeholder in prod instead of the photo.
defects_discovered.root_cause: The home page is static-prerendered; the hero branch used a build-time fs probe existsSync(process.cwd()/public/hero.jpg) which evaluated false under the OpenNext/CI build (process.cwd()/public not resolved like local macOS), baking the placeholder into the shipped HTML even though hero.jpg is committed and serves as a static asset. Local builds resolved it true, so it passed review.
defects_discovered.fix: Replaced the fs probe with a build-time constant HERO_PHOTO_PRESENT and serve /hero.jpg directly via next/image unoptimized (commit bc62fe7). Verified the prerendered output + OpenNext route cache bake with zero placeholder; deployed version 0b2c5c32 (PR #43); confirmed live on the authenticated home page.

decisions.title: Sprint 2 deployed live to production
decisions.summary: CF Worker version b401df32-4015-48b1-b09d-889ff4c10812, merge commit 21471d0 (PR #41), serving angelaandbrooks.com.

decisions.title: "Fig & Foliage" palette and a font-size type scale are live
decisions.summary: Nine color tokens verified in the served HTML (AAA text 10.24:1, AA primary 7.12:1) and a font-size token scale (added 4xl=2rem); the hardcoded Georgia, serif fallback is removed.

decisions.title: Named plus-ones are first-class Guests, verified end-to-end on prod
decisions.summary: The +1 write-back minted g068, was idempotent on (party_id + normalized name), and the sheet was restored to snapshot (reversible). Supersedes the Sprint-1 is_plus_one-from-empty-guest_id / no-write-back rule per ADR 019eebb3-f8db; CONTEXT.md updated, alignment PASS.

decisions.title: HTTPS redirect and HSTS are live
decisions.summary: A 308 http to https redirect and a Strict-Transport-Security header are live; the not-secure warning is resolved.

decisions.title: angelaandbrooks.com custom domain confirmed serving
decisions.summary: The existing Cloudflare dashboard custom-domain binding serves the apex per ADR 019eebb3-fedc; documented, not re-wired.

decisions.title: ESLint config scopes the CI lint gate to src/
decisions.summary: eslint now ignores .claude, .excn, and scripts so the CI lint hard-gate stays scoped to src/ — needed once the framework dirs became tracked in the Sprint-1 close.

decisions.title: Rollback anchors for the Sprint-2 deploy
decisions.summary: git tag sprint-1-stable and CF version cd83d58b (the prior deploy) are the rollback anchors.

retrospective_notes.title: Committing .excn/.claude widened the CI lint gate
retrospective_notes.body: The first-time commit of .claude/.excn in the Sprint-1 close silently extended the CI lint gate to the framework dirs; caught pre-merge and fixed with eslint ignores. The framework stamped eslint/CI config could ignore .claude/.excn by default.

retrospective_notes.title: A mid-sprint token system must be adopted on every surface the same sprint
retrospective_notes.body: design-reviewer caught an admin a11y contrast miss (+1 badge 2.22:1) and the admin surface not adopting the new type-scale tokens — both fixed. When a token system lands mid-sprint, every surface including admin must adopt it that sprint; disjoint-domain build agents can miss a shared cross-cutting rule unless the slice calls it out explicitly.

retrospective_notes.title: Parallel edit-only build with single-committer integration ran race-free
retrospective_notes.body: Two edit-only build agents on disjoint file domains plus single-committer integration (no agent running cf:build, git, or a dev server) ran without index races — worth reusing.

retrospective_notes.title: Parked tech-debt remains in the P3 backlog
retrospective_notes.body: Not actioned this sprint, already filed P3: CI actions v4 to v5 (019eebc2-ff97), prune dead ADMIN_USER_2/PASS_2 (019eebc3-0bc4), color-only-links a11y (019eebc3-05cd), env-contract doc (019eebc2-f999).

retrospective_notes.title: Env-fragile build-time fs checks diverge local versus CI
retrospective_notes.body: The home hero shipped the 'Photo coming soon' placeholder (DEF-hero-1) because a build-time existsSync(process.cwd()/public/hero.jpg) probe resolved true on local macOS but false under the OpenNext/CI build, baking the wrong branch into the static-prerendered HTML. Build-deterministic signals (constants, static imports) carry the same value local and in CI; the divergence was only observable in the prerendered output (.next/.open-next), not in the locally rendered page that review checked.
